text:
meera.gupta: Heads-up — AcmeCorp asked for a fast POC: hosted keys for rapid testing, but they also want a short window on a Dedicated pool and VPC peering for eval data. Can we map out the handoff checklist?

alex_chung: Cool. Are they expecting full Private deployment or just VPC peering into our Private offering?

meera.gupta: Initial ask is VPC peering + dedicated capacity for 2 weeks. If perf looks good they'll expand to Private. Security sent over a short questionnaire too.

jordan_r: Ok. For Dedicated we need: capacity ID, target QPS, model family (+quantization preference), and desired region. Do we have those?

meera.gupta: They want ~150 qps burst, steady 40 qps. Model: open-llama-70b if possible, otherwise 13b quantized. Region: us-west-2.

alex_chung: That QPS for 70b will need multiple GPU slots. I'll estimate nodes and cost. Quick ask: do they require token-level logging disabled? Security Q says logs must not persist outside tenant scope.

taylor_ops: @alex_chung I can draft the Dedicated sizing + cost estimate. For VPC peering we need their ASN, allowed CIDR ranges, and whether they want route-based or policy-based peering. Add to checklist: IAM bindings for their SREs.

meera.gupta: Security questionnaire highlights: data residency, KMS for keys, audit logs, and support for rotating API keys. They asked about SOC2 / ISO docs — legal already handed them the SOC2 report.

jordan_r: For the POC runbook I'll create a short step list. Proposed runbook items:
- create ephemeral Hosted API key for initial dev
- provision Dedicated pool (confirm region & model)
- apply tenant-level KMS + disable token logging by default
- setup VPC peering and test route table
- create SRE role + send IAM docs
- smoke test with sample prompt set and latency targets
- collect perf metrics and cost run-rate

alex_chung: Nice. Add rollout/fallback plan: if 70b latency > target, auto-fallback to 13b quantized and set canary traffic 20% for 1 hour.

taylor_ops: I'll upload a minimal terraform snippet for peering and a shell command to create the dedicated pool. Paste below for the thread:
```
# create dedicated pool (example)
redwoodctl pools create --name acme-poc --region us-west-2 --gpus a100 --replicas 2 --model open-llama-13b-ql8

# create peering request
redwoodctl networking vpc-peer --tenant acme --their-asn 64512 --their-cidr 10.4.0.0/16 --route-type route-based
```

meera.gupta: Perfect. Can someone own the security questionnaire answers and KMS onboarding? I'll handle the customer comms and calendar invites.

jordan_r: I'll take the sec questionnaire. Will confirm KMS options: customer-managed keys (preferred) vs Redwood-managed. I'll send draft answers by EOD.

sales-eng: FYI, buyer asked about temporary discount for POC consumption — marketing ok with a one-time 50% usage credit for the first 2 weeks. Need finance approval.

alex_chung: Noted. I'll include cost Delta in the sizing doc and flag for finance review.

taylor_ops: Action items:
- alex_chung: sizing + cost estimate (ETA 4h)
- jordan_r: questionnaire + KMS doc (ETA EOD)
- taylor_ops: terraform snippets + pool creation steps (ETA 2h)
- meera.gupta: customer comms + calendar (ETA 1h)
- sales-eng: confirm promo credit with finance (ETA 6h)

meera.gupta: Thanks team — I'll run the kickoff at 10a PT tomorrow and share the runbook link. Ping me if blockers pop up. :rocket:
